record.name: Ask Chat AI: ChatASK
record.offering: Productivity app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
ChatASK is an all-in-one chatbot and creative assistant for natural conversations, clear answers, writing, learning and content creation. Ask anything, continue with follow-up questions, create polished text and turn prompts into images — all in one place.

WRITE AND IMPROVE

• Draft emails, essays, captions, replies, notes and new ideas.
• Rewrite awkward wording, check grammar, adjust the tone and translate.
• Turn long passages and web pages into concise, useful summaries.

LEARN AND SOLVE

• Get clear explanations for everyday questions and unfamiliar subjects.
• Work through maths problems step by step and understand the method.
• Brainstorm outlines, revision notes, examples and fresh approaches to a task.

CREATE AND USE ANYWHERE

• Generate images by describing what you would like to see.
• Speak instead of typing with convenient voice input.
• Use the smart keyboard to write and improve text in other apps.
• Reach ChatASK more quickly with widgets and a companion for your watch.

From coursework and professional messages to creative projects and quick questions, ChatASK helps turn a blank page or untidy draft into something useful. Describe the result you need and keep going.

- Terms of Use: https://lykovstudio.io/terms

record.name: ChatXPR: AI Chat & Images
record.offering: Productivity app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
ChatXPR brings the best AI models together in a single app. Ask a question, write, translate, analyze a document, create or transform an image, and generate short videos — with the model best suited to each task, chosen automatically or by you.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Chat with leading models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, DeepSeek and Moonshot, in one conversation history.
• Auto mode: XPR routes each request to the model that handles it best.
• Second opinion: have another AI check an answer and tell you whether it agrees.
• Images: generate images from text, or transform your photos with 28 ready-made styles.
• Studio: try a new haircut, color, beard, outfit or age on your own photo before you commit.
• Documents: get a resume, a report or a web page as a ready-to-send PDF, Word, Excel or PowerPoint file.
• Files: upload PDF, Word, Excel and images to get summaries, extractions and answers.
• Agents: ready-made experts (medical, legal, developer, finance, cooking and more), or create your own.
• My brief: your own daily newsletter on the topics you choose, at the time you choose.
• Apps: connect Gmail, Google Calendar, Notion, Slack and more, and just ask.
• Video: turn a prompt into a short video (Pro+ and Pro Max).
• Web search when a question needs fresh information.
• Dictation, dark mode and 30 languages. Your conversations sync with your account on chatxpr.ai.

PLANS
ChatXPR is free to try. Optional subscriptions (Pro, Pro+, Pro Max) unlock more messages, premium models, more images and monthly videos. Subscriptions renew automatically and can be cancelled at any time in your Apple ID settings.

Terms of use: https://chatxpr.ai/info/terms.php
Privacy policy: https://chatxpr.ai/info/privacy.php

FERTIGE ASSISTENTEN
Wähle einen Assistenten für deine Aufgabe (Reiseplaner, Lernhilfe, E-Mail-Schreiber und mehr) und leg los.

SCHREIBSTUDIO
E-Mails, Übersetzungen, Zusammenfassungen, Korrektur, Umformulierung, Aufsätze, Bildtexte und Beiträge.

BILDSTUDIO
Beschreibe eine Idee in einem Satz und erhalte ein Bild. Gib deinen Fotos einen neuen Stil.

HILFE PER FOTO
Bei einer Frage festgefahren? Mach ein Foto und erhalte eine Schritt-für-Schritt-Erklärung.

VOM FOTO ZUM VIDEO
Bring Bewegung in deine Fotos, mit einem kurzen KI-Video.

DOKUMENTENSTUDIO
Chatte mit deinen PDF-, DOC- oder TXT-Dateien: Zusammenfassungen, Antworten und Kernaussagen.

VIDEO- UND LINK-ZUSAMMENFASSUNGEN
Füge einen YouTube- oder Web-Link ein und erhalte die wichtigsten Punkte.

KI-TASTATUR
Schreibe und verbessere Antworten in jeder App.

SPRECHEN STATT TIPPEN
Sprich deine Frage aus, myAIChat macht Text daraus.

TEXT AUS BILDERN & WEBSUCHE
Hol Text aus Bildern und finde aktuelle Informationen.

HANDY UND WEB
Deine Chats auf dem Handy und im Web unter myaichat.app.

ABONNEMENT
Der Download von myAIChat ist kostenlos. Premium schaltet unbegrenzten Zugriff auf alle Funktionen frei, mit einem Wochen- oder Jahresabo; eventuell ist eine kostenlose Testphase enthalten. Die Zahlung wird bei Kaufbestätigung über Ihren Apple-Account abgerechnet. Das Abonnement verlängert sich automatisch, sofern es nicht mindestens 24 Stunden vor Ende des aktuellen Zeitraums gekündigt wird. READY-MADE ASSISTANTS
Pick an assistant for the job (trip planner, study helper, email writer and more) and start chatting.

WRITING STUDIO
Emails, translations, summaries, proofreading, rewriting, essays, captions and posts.

IMAGE STUDIO
Describe an idea in one sentence and get an image. Give your own photos a new style.

PHOTO HELP
Stuck on a question? Take a photo and get a step-by-step explanation.

PHOTO TO VIDEO

DOC STUDIO
Chat with your PDF, DOC or TXT files: summaries, answers and key points.

VIDEO & LINK SUMMARIES

AI KEYBOARD
Write and improve replies inside any app.

TALK INSTEAD OF TYPING
Say your question and myAIChat turns your voice into text.

TEXT FROM IMAGES & WEB SEARCH
Pull text out of pictures and look up current information.

PHONE AND WEB
Your chats on your phone and on the web at myaichat.app.

record.name: Halo - Personal AI
record.offering: Productivity app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Halo is a personal AI companion that connects to the sources already on your phone (mail, calendar, reminders, health, music, and more) and helps you act on what matters. There's no backend storing your information. Your emails, memories, and context stay entirely on your device, every connection is made directly from your phone, and AI runs through API keys you control.

As you use Halo, it builds a private memory of facts about you: your identity, preferences, relationships, and routines, synthesized from your connected sources. Over time it becomes genuinely useful because it actually knows you, without that knowledge ever leaving your hands. Private by architecture, not by promise.

Features:

- A private memory that grows with you
Halo builds a wiki-style knowledge base from your connected sources. It writes notes by topic, organizes them, and links related ones together. Think of it as a second brain that stays on your device. Open Settings > Memory > Memory Graph to see how everything connects.

- Search by meaning, not just keywords
Ask "When is my next trip?" and Halo finds "Flight to Tokyo departs Friday," even though the words don't match. It passes the most relevant details to the AI before it answers, so replies are personal and grounded in your own information. That search runs entirely on your phone.

- An agent that gets things done
Halo breaks a request into steps, picks the right tools, and follows through. It can research a topic, organize information, work with files, and take action across your connected services, instead of just telling you what to do.

- Bring your own AI
Connect the AI provider you prefer using your own API key, and switch any time. You choose who processes your requests, and there's no middleman server.

- Connect your favorite services
Use MCP connectors to link the apps and services you already use. Browser automations let Halo work with websites you're already signed in to.

- Recurring tasks
Schedule Halo to check for updates, gather information, or handle routine online tasks on a regular basis. Everything runs on your device, and you can review what happened.

- A built-in workspace for files
Halo has its own command-line environment to create, search, organize, and transform files, and to run scripts when a task calls for it. You never have to type a command yourself.

- Your day at a glance
Halo pulls together your calendar, reminders, and email into timely insights and a timeline of what's coming up, so nothing slips through the cracks.

- Smarter email
Get reply suggestions that match your writing style, or tell Halo in plain words how to shape a reply ("make it shorter," "confirm the meeting").

- Private by architecture
Your data, memories, and connections stay on your device, and every request goes straight from your phone to the service you chose.

record.description_evidence:
Lucie is your personal AI — the Life OS for what matters.

You say what matters. Lucie learns your days — calendar, sleep, energy, attention, the people in them — and helps your actions match.

Silence is the default. Lucie speaks when something changed, not when a timer went off.


ASK ONCE — LUCIE HANDLES IT

A held hour. A quieter morning. A table booked. A two-minute reflection.
Need something from the web? Lucie compares prices across shops, checks if a hotel has rooms on your dates, finds the cheapest flight — and comes back with the options and a link to each.
When you're ready, Lucie finishes it: books the table, buys the ticket, places the order. If a site asks for a sign-in or a payment, you see exactly which fields, and nothing is sent until you confirm.
Type or speak. The longer Lucie knows you, the less you have to explain.


YOUR LIFE OS

Commitments, not checklists. Goals and habits Lucie actually holds with you — and when one is off pace, Lucie says why and what got in the way.
Patterns from your own data: the night after too many meetings, the hour that always slips. See one that isn't you? Tap "Not me."
A memory of you that you can see, edit, and forget.
Radar for what's coming: a deadline, a birthday, the reply you're waiting on.


EVERY MORNING, YOUR DAY IN TWENTY SECONDS

Three meetings before noon. An afternoon that's actually free. The deep work you keep pushing.
Lucie briefs you from your real calendar — then watches for the invite that lands on the evening you wanted for your family.
Right now shows your day at a glance, in the order you choose.


PROTECT YOUR ATTENTION

The average person scrolls ten years of their life away. Not you.
Block Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, or any app that takes more than it gives.
Protect your mornings, your work hours, your evenings, your sleep.
Set a daily allowance. Go past it and nothing slams shut — every extra visit simply passes through a habit first.
Open a blocked app with something real: a minute of breathwork. You're never punished. You're redirected.


BODY, SLEEP, AND MIND

Workouts and a weekly plan written around you. Track every set and see which muscles did the work.
Today's readings, your body statistics, and the patterns Lucie found over time.
Breathwork with the rhythm drawn as a line, guided relaxation, and what Lucie noticed across your sessions.


CONNECT THE SIGNALS

Calendar. Sleep and body — Whoop, Oura, Strava, Apple Health. Screen time, counted not guessed.
Each one you connect makes Lucie more specific.
The connections were already in your data. Nobody has ever read them back to you.


PRIVATE BY DESIGN

You choose what Lucie can see. You can disconnect any source.
Lucie never sees what you do inside your apps.
Need a conversation that leaves no trace? Secret chat isn't saved, isn't remembered, and erases itself.
What you reclaim is yours. So is your data.


SEE WHAT YOU GOT BACK

A weekly recap of what held, what slipped, what changed.
Hours reclaimed. Habits kept. Patterns named. Never a number against you.


FIVE PILLARS, ONE LIFE

Attention. Body. Sleep. Soul. Connections.
Every brief, every catch, every habit at a blocked door feeds a bigger picture of the life you're building.

Your personal AI. For what matters.

listing_variants.description:
Lucie is your personal AI — the Life OS for what matters.

You say what matters. Lucie learns your days — calendar, sleep, energy, attention, the people in them — and helps your actions match.

Silence is the default. Lucie speaks when something changed, not when a timer went off.


ASK ONCE — LUCIE HANDLES IT

A held hour. A quieter morning. A table booked. A two-minute reflection.
Need something from the web? Lucie compares prices across shops, checks if a hotel has rooms on your dates, finds the cheapest flight — and comes back with the options and a link to each.
When you're ready, Lucie finishes it: books the table, buys the ticket, places the order. If a site asks for a sign-in or a payment, you see exactly which fields, and nothing is sent until you confirm.
Type or speak. The longer Lucie knows you, the less you have to explain.


YOUR LIFE OS

Commitments, not checklists. Goals and habits Lucie actually holds with you — and when one is off pace, Lucie says why and what got in the way.
Patterns from your own data: the night after too many meetings, the hour that always slips. See one that isn't you? Tap "Not me."
A memory of you that you can see, edit, and forget.
Radar for what's coming: a deadline, a birthday, the reply you're waiting on.


EVERY MORNING, YOUR DAY IN TWENTY SECONDS

Three meetings before noon. An afternoon that's actually free. The deep work you keep pushing.
Lucie briefs you from your real calendar — then watches for the invite that lands on the evening you wanted for your family.
Right now shows your day at a glance, in the order you choose.


PROTECT YOUR ATTENTION

The average person scrolls ten years of their life away. Not you.
Block Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, or any app that takes more than it gives.
Protect your mornings, your work hours, your evenings, your sleep.
Set a daily allowance. Go past it and nothing slams shut — every extra visit simply passes through a habit first.
Open a blocked app with something real: a minute of breathwork. You're never punished. You're redirected.


BODY, SLEEP, AND MIND

Workouts and a weekly plan written around you. Track every set and see which muscles did the work.
Today's readings, your body statistics, and the patterns Lucie found over time.
Breathwork with the rhythm drawn as a line, guided relaxation, and what Lucie noticed across your sessions.


CONNECT THE SIGNALS

Calendar. Sleep and body — Whoop, Oura, Strava, Apple Health. Screen time, counted not guessed.
Each one you connect makes Lucie more specific.
The connections were already in your data. Nobody has ever read them back to you.


PRIVATE BY DESIGN

You choose what Lucie can see. You can disconnect any source.
Lucie never sees what you do inside your apps.
Need a conversation that leaves no trace? Secret chat isn't saved, isn't remembered, and erases itself.
What you reclaim is yours. So is your data.


SEE WHAT YOU GOT BACK

A weekly recap of what held, what slipped, what changed.
Hours reclaimed. Habits kept. Patterns named. Never a number against you.


FIVE PILLARS, ONE LIFE

Attention. Body. Sleep. Soul. Connections.
Every brief, every catch, every habit at a blocked door feeds a bigger picture of the life you're building.

Your personal AI. For what matters.
